title: metadata: migrateDatabaseLoaderRowPackages keys its slot-taken test without the bundle member, so an unbound email template row beside a column-bound row of another locale is left unbound
body:
epic:#31527#1 · os-bill · session_01Utp6CYGYEUhpi29FpjLmxT

Filing gate: ① product defect with a named location, found by reading. Carried out of PR #32214's contract review 6809461650 (outside its diff) by epic ruling 6809488921. Part of #31527 (ADR-0150).

## 维护者速读

- 改什么：存储引用迁移（`migrateDatabaseLoaderRowPackages`）判断"槽已被占"时没有带上语言成员。
- 为什么：同一个邮件模板，若已有一种语言的行按列绑定了包，另一种语言的未绑定行会被误判成"槽已被占"，一直留在未绑定状态。
- 风险：只影响升级回填，第一方 0 处；行不会丢，只是没绑上。
- 先看：`packages/metadata` 里 `migrateDatabaseLoaderRowPackages` 的 slot-taken 判断；可参照 #32214 第 6 轮按成员写行的规则。
- 验证：同一模板放一行已绑定的 en-US 和一行未绑定的 fr-FR，跑迁移后 fr-FR 应绑到同一个包。
- 需要你做的：无，归专题席派发。

## The defect

`migrateDatabaseLoaderRowPackages` keys its slot-taken test by `(type, package, name)` without the bundle member. Take an unbound `email_template` row of locale `fr-FR` beside a column-bound row of the same name in locale `en-US`. The `fr-FR` row is reported `slot-taken` and left unbound, though its member's slot is free. Read by the contract reviewer, not yet run.

Expected: the slot-taken test keys by member for a bundled type, as `DatabaseLoader.save`'s member-aware target does after #32214 round 6. A truly taken member slot is still reported, never overwritten (epic red line 2).

reach: the upgrade backfill on a deployment with per-locale email template rows. First-party: 0.

## Reader

The epic seat `epic:#31527#1` dispatches it after PR #32214 lands. Pin it red first.

Dedupe (open and closed): `migrateDatabaseLoaderRowPackages`, `slot-taken bundle member` → none.
Grade: p2.
